nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Primary project documentation covering installation, quick start, typed message maps, static and dynamic provider connections, every hook (useSubscription, useSend, useConnectionState, useWebSocket, useDynamicConnection, useCloseClient), connection options, backoff strategies, the framework-agnostic client, and React Strict Mode behavior.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: npm package manifest for react-socket-link v0.1.0 defining dual ESM/CJS dist exports with type declarations, Vite/Vitest/tsc scripts, React >=17 peer dependency, and build tooling devDependencies.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the conditional `exports` map (types/import/require) plus `sideEffects: false` to enable tree-shaking for both ESM and CommonJS consumers.

nodes.name: tsconfig.app.json
nodes.summary: Vite-style TypeScript config for the src directory targeting ES2023 + DOM with bundler module resolution, react-jsx, verbatim module syntax, and strict unused-code linting.

nodes.name: tsconfig.build.json
nodes.summary: Build-only TypeScript config extending tsconfig.json to emit .d.ts declarations into dist/ from src while excluding test files, used by the build script and vite-plugin-dts.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Root TypeScript config for editor IntelliSense and typechecking, enabling strict mode, ES2020 target, bundler resolution and react-jsx across src, tests, examples, and Vite/Vitest configs.

nodes.name: tsconfig.node.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript config for Node-side tooling files (vite.config.ts) targeting ES2023 with Node types, bundler resolution, and no emit.
